_comment: Copyleft dependencies permitted with a recorded decision. See docs/adr/ADR-007.

allowed.reason: Astrological core. We ship it as a WASM dependency and do NOT modify it, so AGPL section 13 network-copyleft attaches to the combined work only if the service is offered over a network AND we choose the AGPL branch. The commercial licence is the fallback if a closed-source white-label customer objects.
